diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says GND, datasheet reading says 4
diffs.evidence: Adafruit #1362 Eagle board file: 'Input' header JP3 silkscreen from the label end reads Gnd (y=1.778), 0 (5.207), 1 (7.747), 2 (10.287), 3 (12.827), 4 (15.24); 'Output' header JP1 reads VDD (1.778), 0 (4.318), 1 (6.858), 2 (9.398), 3 (12.065), 4 (14.478). Nets confirm: GND->JP3 pad 6 (bottom, beside 'Gnd'), VDD->JP1 pad 1 (beside 'VDD'), GO/OUT1..OUT4 (IC1 pins 3,8,7,6,5)->JP1 pads 2..6, touch inputs via 10k R1-R5 ->JP3 pads 5..1. The model lists both headers in the same physical direction (Gnd/VDD end first), matching the silkscreen rows; the second reading reversed the order (and inconsistently, since VDD is JP1 pad 1, not pad 6). Same pins and functions, only list order differs. Position 1 of the model (GND) is the correct function at that physical position.
